# Pinterest Russia

> > Pinterest Russia (ru.pinterest.com) — Russian-language visual discovery platform featuring curated collections of creative ideas, DIY crafts, printable templates, and artistic inspiration.

This is the Russian version of Pinterest, showcasing user-generated boards and pins focused on crafts, paper projects, printable templates, and creative DIY tutorials. Content includes both Russian-language materials and international creative resources organized by Russian-speaking users.

## Key Topics

- Printable templates
- Paper crafts
- DIY projects
- Letter stencils
- Craft templates
- Sewing tutorials
- Kitchen crafts
- Character design
- Fabric crafts
- Box templates
- Patchwork
- Quilted items
- Digital downloads
- Kids crafts
- Creative tutorials

- [Stencil Letter Small N | Lettering, Cute boyfriend gifts, Letter stencils](https://ru.pinterest.com/crafts-pin/letter-n-printable-stencil-templates--595460382010531432/): Printable letter N stencil templates from stencilletters.org
- [Printable French Fry Boxes | Box template printable, Box template, Templates printable free](https://ru.pinterest.com/crafts-pin/9288742971015119/): French fry box template printables from Printablee for DIY packaging
